headline: Argentina Country Risk Spikes Above 1,000 Basis Points Amid Market Sell-Off
summary: Argentina's sovereign risk index rose above 1,000 basis points after local equity indices fell 0.3% and foreign exchange rates depreciated across official and parallel markets.
why: Country risk spreads track the yield premium investors demand to hold domestic sovereign debt relative to US Treasuries.

impacts.name: Argentina Sovereign Bond Spreads
impacts.why: Country risk surpassing 1,000 bps reflects widening default spreads on sovereign debt.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
